# Theme Token

> Publish, discover, and install ShadCN-compatible themes as 1Sat Ordinals on BSV.

## Canonical links

- App: https://themetoken.dev
- Specification: https://themetoken.dev/spec
- Theme Studio: https://themetoken.dev/studio/theme
- Schema: https://themetoken.dev/v1/schema.json
- SDK: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@theme-token/sdk

## Install a theme

```bash
bunx shadcn@latest add https://themetoken.dev/r/themes/[origin]
```

`[origin]` is a 1Sat origin outpoint in `txid_vout` form. The optional `.json`
suffix is accepted, but the suffixless URL above is canonical.

## Theme document

A Theme Token document requires `$schema`, `name`, and light/dark `styles`.
`author`, chart colors, sidebar colors, fonts, shadows, backgrounds, bundle data,
and generation provenance are optional. Each mode requires the 19 ShadCN semantic
colors plus `radius`. Values are stored as CSS strings; colors normally use OKLCH.

## On-chain package

Themes are published as an `ord-fs/json` directory containing `theme.json`.
The directory manifest carries MAP discovery metadata:

```json
{
  "app": "theme-token",
  "type": "registry:style",
  "name": "Theme Name",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "ShadCN theme: Theme Name"
}
```

Fonts use `registry:font`; patterns, wallpapers, and icons use `registry:file`;
project presets use `registry:base`. Raw content is served from
`https://api.1sat.app/content/[origin]`.

The registry endpoint validates the Theme Token document and returns a ShadCN
`registry:style` item with direct OKLCH values in `cssVars`.
